messages.subject: For Hamad Al-Khater | Global aviation, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Qatar Airways Media Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Hamad Ali Al-Khater, Group Chief Executive Officer.

Qatar Airways' global network and next phase of growth require disciplined alignment across governments, aviation authorities, airports, strategic partners and operating teams. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and global stakeholder strategy might support Qatar Airways' priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Qatar Airways.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
